generation_prompt.prompt: Create a formal {{size}} agent recognition or award social media post for {{brand_name}}. Style: prestigious professional recognition — agent portrait prominently on the right side, award or recognition headline text on the left, brand logo at top. Background: {{color_palette.background}}. Accent: {{color_palette.primary}}. The design must feel like a formal award announcement — dignified and premium.
generation_prompt.important_instruction: Layout: BRAND LOGO top-center, AGENT PORTRAIT right side (face clearly visible in upper third, subject at least half-body), award or recognition headline text large on left in {{color_palette.primary}} and {{color_palette.text}}, supporting copy below headline, decorative border or frame element in {{color_palette.primary}}, branded footer at bottom. The portrait must be clearly visible and undistorted. Do not obscure the agent's face.
